title: unified-rollouts-enhance-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflows
author: Ravi Shah
description:
Motivation: Improve safety and observability for canary/AB/shadow rollouts by extending auto-rollback workflows to support multi-metric thresholds, probe windows, and explicit observability hooks. This addresses customer incidents where transient metric spikes and noisy sampling caused premature or delayed rollbacks. The change centralizes policy evaluation, adds a lightweight probing controller, and surfaces rollout signals to the Console.

What this PR does: 1) Adds a probe stage to staged shadow/canary rollouts to detect regression windows before applying traffic weight changes. 2) Implements composite metric evaluation (latency P95, error_rate, and model-quality regression) with configurable aggregation windows and operator (any/all). 3) Exposes rollback signals and metric deltas to the rollout tracing span and Console dashboard. 4) Adds safety guards: min-run-duration, probe-retries, and backoff before forced rollback. 5) Includes integration tests and unit tests for the controller and e2e coverage for a simple canary flow.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-4821)
- [x] Implementation of policy engine + probe controller
- [x] Unit tests for policy evaluation
- [x] Integration test for canary -> auto-rollback
- [x] Console metrics and rollout traces surfaced
- [x] Release notes and migration guide

Notes/compatibility: The rollout policy introduces two new top-level fields in rollout spec: "probe_window" and "composite_metrics". Backwards compatible defaults preserve previous behavior if fields are omitted. Migration guide included in docs/rollouts/migrations.md.

References: Linear ENG-4821; related PRs pr-331213-unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-rollback-observability and pr-541210-unified-rollouts-proactive-canary-shadow-autorollback-workflows.
